Yes, [Omnicell](https://www.omnicell.com/) systems are classified as healthcare technology and regulated medical devices or automated medical equipment. They function as automated medication dispensing cabinets, robotic pharmacy systems, and inventory management hardware used in hospitals to securely store, track, and dispense pharmaceuticals. [](https://www.omnicell.com/)

- Regulated by health agencies like the FDA as automated compounding or dispensing systems.

- Used by clinical staff to manage secure medication storage and reduce human error.

- Combines physical automated hardware, robotics, and cloud software. [](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/medical-device-recalls-and-early-alerts/automated-compounding-system-recall-omnicell-removes-syringe-labels-used-ivstation-automated)

### Core Product Categories

- **Automated Dispensing Cabinets (ADCs):**

Secure, nurse-accessed station units on hospital floors.

- **Central Pharmacy Robotics:** Automated central systems like the XR2 system that organize and pick stock.

- **Compounding Systems:** Automated robotic devices that prepare intravenous (IV) preparations. [](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/medical-device-recalls-and-early-alerts/automated-compounding-system-recall-omnicell-removes-syringe-labels-used-ivstation-automated)
